svg.text: SENSOR-NTC v2 — Bare ESP32-C6-WROOM-1U + TPS63802 + ESP-PROG header
2× L91 (or TL-4903) → TPS63802 buck-boost → WROOM-1U. Flashed via ESP-PROG over 2×3 IDC. Inter-block connections by named-net flags — no crossing wires.
Battery → cell-side buffer caps → TPS63802 → 3V3 OUT
V_out = 0.5 V × (1 + R_FB1/R_FB2) = 0.5 × (1+5.6) = 3.30 V. R_FB2 ≤ 100 kΩ per datasheet. Single L1_ext between L1 and L2 pins. C_buf_e+C_buf_c = HLC substitute.
Taps raw BAT+ (before regulator) for % reporting
Module body in centre. Pin stubs exit LEFT to named-net flags. Decoupling, pullups, u.FL on right.
External 2.4 GHz dipole via u.FL pigtail.
No GPIO14 RF switch on v2 — direct routing.
Maintain Espressif RF keepout around connector.
R5 SIZING: match R5 to the NTC resistance at the MIDDLE of your operating range,
not at 25 °C. 47 kΩ suits a −20 °C cold probe (NTC ≈ 36 k at −5 °C). A 10 kΩ R5
centres at +25 °C and drives this low-side divider into ADC saturation below ~0 °C.
Block 5 — Programming header J_PROG (2×3 IDC, 2.54 mm)
Espressif ESP-PROG UART standard pinout. Plug ESP-PROG ribbon directly. Set ESP-PROG VDD jumper to 3.3 V.
"IO0" silkscreen on ESP-PROG is legacy for classic ESP32 BOOT; on C6 this maps to GPIO9.
No auto-reset transistors or coupling caps on this PCB — ESP-PROG owns all of that.
Moved off GPIO15 (strap pin) to GPIO5. Driving HIGH lights LED.
HW RESET — pulls EN low to force chip reset.
USER BUTTON — firmware factory-reset (hold 3 s) + deep-sleep wakeup.
Firmware: delete XIAO GPIO3/14 antenna-switch block, change LED_PIN 15 → 5 (BOARD_REV=2 build flag handles both).
